question: Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:The trainees were directed (1)/ to finish the report promptly (2)/ and submit it (3)/ with clear writing. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part **4** of the sentence: "**with clear writing**."
 
• The phrase "**with clear writing**" is awkward and lacks grammatical correctness.
 
• It should be revised to "**in clear handwriting**" to convey the intended meaning correctly.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The trainees were directed to finish the report promptly and submit it in clear handwriting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The trainees were directed"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "to finish the report promptly"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "and submit it"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
